verdict.rationale: Viam's own materials claim every element of the story: OTA updates for software and ML models, canary testing and rollbacks, and models that can be versioned, staged and rolled back "just like code." Remote updates without SSH and managed module versioning and deployment back this up. The support rests on marketing bullets rather than in-depth documentation. missing for 10: detailed docs on the staged-rollout mechanics (e.g., percentage or cohort targeting, version pinning across a fleet), a documented rollback procedure for software or modules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
